stories.title: 100 games that explain college football in 2026
stories.summary: TV, realignment, stars and legends, postseason quarrels. Those themes have set up epic games and made the current sport.

stories.title: Sources: Bieniemy's wife shot at couple's home
stories.summary: The wife of Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy was allegedly shot by the couple's son Sunday night at the family's home in Virginia.

stories.title: UNC places top Belichick aide Lombardi on leave
stories.summary: North Carolina football GM Michael Lombardi, a top aide to coach Bill Belichick, has been placed on paid administrative leave by the university.

stories.title: 76ers welcome LeBron with coronation fit for King
stories.summary: The 76ers and LeBron James announced Monday their two-year deal on the veteran's minimum for $8 million total was official and that the four-time NBA MVP was indeed a Sixer.

stories.title: Manuel gets $7.14M, other perks in U-M buyout
stories.summary: Departing Michigan athletic director Warde Manuel will receive a $7 million lump sum payment as part of his separation deal, according to a document obtained Monday by The Associated Press.
